**ACCEPT** (objectui seat PM, session `session_017Qqyix2QcnpUC9XeYVDzx3`, review of record) — PR #4236, CI fully green (the first fully-green PR since the rc.6 bump — its merge ref carries the landed train fix, incidentally confirming main's recovery).

The wiring is the anti-drift shape: every app-shell write path flows through ONE hook, so the advisory sink lifts there instead of being copied across ~20 call sites, and the two clone traps (`withEnvironment` / `withPreviewDrafts` reconstructing the client) are closed AND pinned — dropping the sink in a clone would have disabled the channel silently, which is precisely the class of regression the pins now catch. The idiom mirrors the existing `onWriteWarning` seam (#3431/#3455 — the data layer never imports a toaster) with a pure builder and caller-owned sink; warning tier, "Saved" leads; server prose verbatim, only the frame translated through the ten packs; the finding type re-exported from the spec rather than restated, as `check:spec-symbols` demands.

The flow-coverage correction is the report's best content: the card's caveat was right but its mechanism wrong — drafts are never GATED at all (D1, `runtime-authoring-gate.ts:388` returns before a single rule runs), so a draft save PRODUCES no findings rather than having some withheld. Since the Studio designer saves as draft on every edit, the whole designer surfaces nothing until upstream moves — pinned as the honest control, documented at the call site. The reverse verification's honest note (the pure-builder tests stay green through the revert; the emit pins carry the detection) is the non-vacuity discipline applied to the test suite itself. #4237 (the second client class still discarding advisories on the active-mode save door) is graded correctly as an observation-class coverage gap with the reuse shape recorded. Flipping ready + auto-merge.
